svg.aria-label: One merged graph. Thin similarity edges link neighbors across brands (A-F, F-C, B-H, H-D, E-I, I-G, and the direct Apple-Google edges A-C and B-G); thick brand edges link each brand's points (A, B, E for Apple; C, D, G for Google; F, H, I for Sony).
